verdict.rationale: Texas SOS's SOSPortal is an online filing, ordering and search service, so offering scoped API credentials for agents is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents only account-based portal access with multi-factor authentication. It shows no API, no API keys and no scoped or least-privilege credential issuance. MFA is an adjacent security control and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
